EC2: - symptomatic orthostatic hypotension [OR] and secondary/ [OR] iatrogenic hypertension [OR] and dyslipidemia
EC3: - history of moderate to severe cerebral ischemia, [OR] cerebral hemorrhage, [OR] transient ischemic attack, [OR] myocardial infarction, [OR] or unstable angina in the past 6 months; severe heart failure (New York Heart Association functional class III and IV)
EC5: - history of angioedema after treatment with angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors [OR] or ARBs; creatinine phosphokinase levels ≥3 times the upper limit of normal
EC6: - estimated glomerular filtration rate ≤30 mL/min; aspartate aminotransferase [OR] and alanine aminotransferase levels ≥3 times the upper limit of normal
EC7: - potassium [OR] levels >5.5 mmol/L; or any diseases that could affect the results of the study.
